opening_source_note: APT/ski.it news: Groste pre-opening 22-23 Nov (announced), official 28 Nov; ski.it 2026/27 sales conditions
piste_km_basis: Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta pass (ski.it 155 km)
score_notes: Off-piste limited to Groste/Spinale bowls and guided Brenta couloirs, no FWT history; Brenta Dolomites give classic but not very varied day tours (Bocca di Brenta, Val d'Agola, Cima Roma).
comments: Pre-opening 22-23 Nov 2025 at Groste announced by APT but not confirmed post hoc (official opening 28 Nov 2025; Pinzolo and Folgarida-Marilleva sectors 4 Dec); 2025/26 Skiarea 1-day adult EUR 74 low / 85 high (max window price), online prices dynamic (ski.it); 'Numero Ideale' skier cap on peak days; 2026/27 season validity from 28 Nov 2026 per ski.it sales conditions (skiresort lists 21 Nov 2026); no pass on route from Milan (A4/A22 or Val Rendena via Tione).

opening_source_note: campigliodolomiti.it season dates (Pinzolo sector 4 Dec 2025, announced); no 2026/27 sector date
piste_km_basis: Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta pass (linked area); Pinzolo sector tops 2100 m
score_notes: Doss del Sabion is a piste-oriented sector with only tree-run off-piste; touring on the Adamello-Presanella side (Val Genova, Val Nambrone) is decent but less developed than Campiglio's Brenta side.
comments: Pinzolo sector (Doss del Sabion 2100 m) linked to Campiglio by gondola; Pinzolo-only 1-day pass 2025/26 EUR 59 low / 65 high also sold; Skiarea pass EUR 85 high with dynamic online pricing; skiresort lists Skiarea season from 21 Nov 2026 (Campiglio sector); base = Pinzolo village, Pinzolo-Pra Rodont gondola at south end.

opening_source_note: campigliodolomiti.it season dates (Folgarida-Marilleva 4 Dec 2025, announced); no 2026/27 sector date
piste_km_basis: Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta pass (linked area via Monte Vigo)
score_notes: Mostly groomed intermediate terrain with some tree skiing off Monte Vigo; Val di Sole touring (Val Meledrio, Peller, Presanella approaches) is modest in variety.
comments: Val di Sole bases: Folgarida gondola (used here), Marilleva 1400 (46.30243, 10.81015) and Daolasa/Commezzadura gondola; same Skiarea pass as Campiglio (dynamic online pricing); sector opened 4 Dec 2025 while Campiglio opened 28 Nov; no pass on Milan route (A22 or SS42 Tonale).

opening_source_note: DSS press 2 Dec 2025 (Sellaronda valleys 4 Dec); fassa.com skiarea pages 2026/27 dates
piste_km_basis: Val di Fassa-Carezza valley pass; sum of fassa.com skiarea km (31+23+36+14)
score_notes: Sella/Pordoi classics (Val Lasties, Forcella Pordoi, Val Mesdi via Pordoi cable car) and Ciampac/Belvedere off-piste with local guides; dense Gulliver route coverage on Sella, Catinaccio, Marmolada and Monzoni.
comments: Valley pass covers Belvedere/Col Rodella, Buffaure/Ciampac, Catinaccio and Carezza only (Alpe Lusia and San Pellegrino are a separate DSS zone); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 68 low / 76 high (high 21 Dec-10 Jan, 1 Feb-21 Mar); DSS 2026/27 whole-area price published (EUR 80/89) but valley prices not yet; new 3S Col Rodella opened Christmas 2025; Carezza sector opened 6 Dec 2025; skiresort quotes ~109 km; from Milan via A22 Ora-Val di Fiemme (no pass), Passo Fedaia/Pordoi/Sella subject to winter closures.

opening_source_note: APT press 25 Nov 2025: San Pellegrino opened 29 Nov (announced), Alpe Lusia 5 Dec; no resort-specific 2026/27 date
piste_km_basis: Alpe Lusia-San Pellegrino valley pass (skiareasanpellegrino.it: 100 km, 23 lifts)
score_notes: Col Margherita (2513 m) has a marked freeride zone and off-piste towards Fuciade; Costabella, Monzoni, Bocche and Lagorai give good documented day tours but the area is small.
comments: Two unlinked sectors: Alpe Lusia (Ronchi/Moena and Bellamonte; base used here) and San Pellegrino-Falcade (pass at 46.36726, 11.80237), joined by free Tre Valli shuttle 20 Dec-15 Mar; Alpe Lusia is also included in the Fiemme-Obereggen valley pass; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 64 low / 71 high; fassa.com lists both skiareas 'open 4 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027' (generic note) and skiresort lists 28 Nov 2026; Passo San Pellegrino road open in winter; the 29 Nov 2025 opening is the announced date, not confirmed post hoc.

opening_source_note: Obereggen opened Fri 28 Nov 2025 (press, confirmed operating 2 Dec); obereggen.com 2026/27 dates
piste_km_basis: Val di Fiemme-Obereggen valley pass (visitfiemme.it 'over 110 km', 50 lifts)
score_notes: Piste-focused family sectors (Cermis, Latemar) with only modest off-piste at Pampeago/Cermis; Lagorai and Latemar have many documented ski tours and an active local touring scene but no high-alpine classics.
comments: Valley pass covers Alpe Cermis (Cavalese, base used here), Latemar Dolomites (Obereggen-Pampeago-Predazzo, top ~2388 m), Bellamonte-Alpe Lusia, Passo Rolle and Oclini; sectors linked only by skibus except Latemar; 2026/27: first lifts Obereggen 27 Nov 2026, Fiemme link 28 Nov, season to 4 Apr 2027; night skiing Obereggen Tue/Fri; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 64 low / 71 high; alternative base Obereggen 46.38500, 11.52597.

opening_source_note: APT news 25 Nov 2025: pre-opening weekend 29-30 Nov (Colbricon Express), full opening 4 Dec; 2026/27 not published
piste_km_basis: San Martino di Castrozza-Passo Rolle valley pass (sanmartino.com 60 km)
score_notes: Tognola/Colverde off-piste, Rosetta cable-car descents and Passo Rolle freeride; Pale di San Martino and Lagorai are among Trentino's best-documented touring grounds (Passo Rolle classics, Val Venegia) with an active guide office.
comments: Official 2025/26 price list: 1-day adult EUR 63 (29 Nov-20 Dec, 11-31 Jan, from 15 Mar) / 70 (21 Dec-10 Jan, 1 Feb-14 Mar); pre-opening weekend ticket EUR 31.50; two sectors (San Martino, Passo Rolle) linked by skibus, lift link planned; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 28 Nov 2026-11 Apr 2027 (unverified); base = Tognola gondola car park; Passo Rolle open in winter (chains may be required).

opening_source_note: neveitalia/Alpe Cimbra 2025/26 list (28 Nov 2025, announced); 2026/27 list says only 'from opening'
piste_km_basis: Skiarea Alpe Cimbra pass (skiresort Folgaria/Fiorentini 74 km; official total not found)
score_notes: Low-altitude family plateau with fully snowmade groomed pistes and almost no off-piste; ski touring limited to gentle Cimbra plateau routes.
comments: 2026/27 price list published: 1-day adult EUR 63 window / 60 online on Saturdays, Sundays, holidays, 19 Dec 2026-6 Jan 2027 and 7-13 Feb 2027; weekdays EUR 57 / 53; Lavarone sector not lift-linked to Folgaria-Fiorentini (skibus); altitude 1177-1824 m; base = Folgaria village (lifts at Francolini/Fondo Grande ~3 km); skiresort lists 2026/27 season from 28 Nov 2026 (unverified); no pass on Milan route (A4/A22 Rovereto).

opening_source_note: Pejo Funivie 2025/26 list via Moveo (6 Dec 2025, announced); 2026/27 list says 'from opening'
piste_km_basis: Skipass Pejo (all Pejo Funivie lifts; skiresort 20 km)
score_notes: Pejo 3000 cable car opens steep off-piste on the Cima Vioz flank and Val de la Mare; gateway to Ortles-Cevedale classics (Vioz, Cevedale, Palon de la Mare, Rif. Larcher) though the lift network is tiny.
comments: 2026/27 price list published: 1-day adult EUR 60 Christmas-New Year (20 Dec 2026-6 Jan 2027), 54 high season (7 Jan-14 Mar 2027), 49 low; 2025/26 was 58/52/48; 7 lifts in Stelvio National Park; Combi and Skiarea Campiglio passes also sold; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 3 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027 (unverified); base = Pejo Fonti gondola; from Milan via SS42 Passo del Tonale (open in winter) or A22-Val di Sole.

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + DSS press (4 Dec 2025); valgardena.it 2026/27 season dates
piste_km_basis: Val Gardena-Alpe di Siusi valley pass (val-gardena.com 175 km, 79 lifts)
score_notes: Seceda, Dantercepies and Ciampinoi off-piste plus Val Mesdi/Val Lasties via Pordoi; Puez-Odle and Sella groups offer many documented Dolomites day tours with strong guide offices in Selva/Ortisei; no FWT history.
comments: 2025/26 valley 1-day adult EUR 72 low / 80 high (official); DSS 2026/27 whole-area price published (EUR 80/89), valley prices pending; 2026/27 lifts and Sellaronda open 4 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027; base = Selva (Ciampinoi/Dantercepies), alternative Ortisei; from Milan via A22 Chiusa (no pass), Passo Sella/Gardena may close in heavy snow.

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + press (4 Dec 2025); 2026/27 = Sellaronda date per valgardena.it, skiresort lists same
piste_km_basis: Alta Badia valley pass (skiresort 130 km; official site not accessible)
score_notes: Val Mesdi (Sella) and Lagazuoi/Val Travenanzes descents are Dolomites off-piste classics with guides in Colfosco/Corvara; Sella, Puez and Fanes groups give many documented tours; no FWT venue.
comments: altabadia.org returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so km/elevation are from skiresort (130 km, top 2778 m Lagazuoi); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 72 low / 80 high; 2026/27 opening date not resort-published, taken from the Sellaronda opening (4 Dec 2026); base = Corvara; passes Gardena/Campolongo/Valparola open in winter with possible closures; from Milan via A22 Bressanone-Val Badia.

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + schneehoehen 2 Dec 2025 (open since 29 Nov, confirmed); 2026/27 not on kronplatz.com yet
piste_km_basis: Kronplatz valley pass (skiresort 125 km, 32 lifts)
score_notes: Rounded piste mountain with little off-piste; ski touring mostly in nearby Antholz/Gsies valleys and Pragser Dolomites, which have many documented routes.
comments: Bases Riscone/Brunico (used here), Valdaora and San Vigilio; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 72 low / 80 high; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 28 Nov 2026-11 Apr 2027 (not verified on official site, which still shows summer); reached via A22 Bressanone-SS49 (no pass).

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + schneehoehen 2 Dec 2025 (open since 29 Nov, confirmed); 2026/27 date not on dreizinnen.com
piste_km_basis: 3 Zinnen Dolomites valley pass (dreizinnen.com/DSS 115 km incl. Haunold, Rienz, Prags, Padola)
score_notes: Rotwand/Croda Rossa and Stiergarten offer moderate off-piste; Sexten Dolomites, Kreuzbergpass and Comelico provide many documented ski tours but a small guiding scene.
comments: Linked Helm-Stiergarten-Rotwand-Kreuzbergpass area is 86 km (skiresort), pass adds Haunold, Rienz, Prags and Padola sectors; base = Versciaco/Vierschach Helm gondola next to rail station (Sesto 46.67197, 12.38705 alternative); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 72 low / 80 high; skiresort lists 2026/27 season 27 Nov 2026-11 Apr 2027 (unverified); 2026/27 season pass published; via Val Pusteria SS49 (no pass).

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + press (5 Dec 2025); seiseralm.it cableway winter 2026/27 dates
piste_km_basis: Val Gardena-Alpe di Siusi valley pass (175 km); Alpe di Siusi sector alone ~73 km (skiresort)
road_head: Siusi (Seis) – Alpe di Siusi cable-car valley station
score_notes: Gentle high plateau with wide groomed pistes and negligible off-piste; some documented tours towards Sciliar/Denti di Terrarossa and Sassopiatto but limited variety.
comments: Road Siusi-Compatsch closed to private cars 09:00-17:00 while the cableway runs (permit holders/hotel guests excepted), so visitors park at the Siusi valley station (garage EUR 12/day, free outdoor lot); cableway 5 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027; standard pass is the Val Gardena-Alpe di Siusi valley pass (2025/26 EUR 72 low / 80 high), lift link to Val Gardena via Monte Pana/Saltria.

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + press (5 Dec 2025); plose.org winter 2026/27 dates
piste_km_basis: Plose local area only (plose.org 'more than 40 km', skiresort 42.5); valley pass adds unlinked Gitschberg Jochtal
score_notes: Long groomed valley runs (Trametsch) with limited off-piste; modest touring around Plose/Peitlerkofel; no freeride reputation.
comments: INCLUSION UNDER REVIEW: local Plose area only ~42 km (7 lifts), below the 60 km basis; the DSS valley pass Rio Pusteria-Bressanone also covers Gitschberg Jochtal ~30 km away (not lift-linked); 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 63 low / 70 high, 2026/27 list 'to be published shortly'; season 5 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027; base = Sant'Andrea/St. Andrae cable-car valley station above Bressanone.

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com/press (glacier 19 Sep 2025, valley runs 29 Nov); official 2026/27 price list Season A from 19 Sep 2026
piste_km_basis: Alpin Arena Senales full-area pass (skiresort 42 km)
score_notes: Glacier off-piste from Grawand/Lazaun and Finail with steep north faces; Similaun, Fineilspitze and Weisskugel are classic Oetztal Alps tours from Maso Corto with strong hut tradition and Sept-May snow.
comments: Glacier skiing Sept-May (autumn mostly race training); 2026/27 price list published: 1-day adult EUR 68 Season A (19 Sep-6 Nov 2026), 50 Season B, 57 Season C (9-29 Jan, 27 Feb-19 Mar 2027), 63 Season D (26 Dec-8 Jan, 30 Jan-26 Feb, 20 Mar-2 Apr 2027); valley runs open from 28 Nov 2026; Suedtirol Skiarena pass also valid; dead-end valley from Naturno (no pass); base = Maso Corto/Kurzras glacier cable car.

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + skiinfo (1 Nov 2025, delayed from late Oct); seilbahnensulden.it 2026/27 pre-season from 24 Oct 2026
piste_km_basis: Sulden am Ortler pass (skiresort 40.2 km; other sources 41-44 km)
score_notes: Steep off-piste in the Madritsch bowls and under the Kanzel with local guides; Ortler group is a classic high-alpine touring hub (Cevedale, Suldenspitze, Vertainspitze, spring Ortler) with strong Ortler Skiarena guide culture.
comments: 2026/27 prices published: 1-day adult EUR 63 main season (19 Dec-8 Jan, 30 Jan-12 Mar, 20 Mar-2 Apr 2027), 60 off-season, 53.50 pre/post season (24 Oct-18 Dec 2026, 17 Apr-2 May 2027); official altitude 1900-3250 m, no lift-served glacier piste; 2026/27 start 24 Oct is the published pre-season start, snow-dependent (snowtrex quotes 1 Nov 2026); access only via Val Venosta-Prato allo Stelvio, Passo Stelvio closed in winter.

opening_source_note: suedtirol.com + skiinfo (6 Dec 2025); schoeneben.it opening hours 2026/27
piste_km_basis: Schoeneben-Haideralm pass (official 65 km, 14 lifts; skiresort 65 km)
score_notes: Sunny intermediate pistes with some bowl/tree off-piste at Haideralm; Reschenpass, Langtaufers and Sesvenna valleys are well-known touring grounds with many documented routes.
comments: 2026/27 published: season 5 Dec 2026-3 Apr 2027, 1-day adult EUR 70 window / 68 online valid 19 Dec 2026-3 Apr 2027 (pre-season 5-18 Dec priced separately); official webcam page is an empty JS shell so bergfex multi-cam used; two sectors Belpiano/Schoeneben (Resia, base used here) and Malga San Valentino/Haideralm linked by lift; Passo Resia open year-round; from Milan via Val Venosta (Merano) or Switzerland/Austria.

opening_source_note: Dolomiti Review 21 Nov 2025: Col Gallina chairlift from 22 Nov (announced), Tofana 4 Dec, Faloria 5 Dec; 2026/27 only 'late Nov-early Dec'
piste_km_basis: Cortina d'Ampezzo valley pass (cortinadampezzo.it ~120 km)
score_notes: Renowned off-piste itineraries (Bus de Tofana, Forcella Rossa, Lagazuoi-Armentarola, Cristallo) with Guide Alpine Cortina and freeride schools; Tofane, Cristallo and Fanes host many documented ski tours; no FWT stop.
comments: Three unlinked sectors (Tofana-Socrepes, Faloria-Cristallo, Lagazuoi-5 Torri) connected by skibus; the 22 Nov 2025 Col Gallina opening is the announced date, official site framed 4 Dec as gradual start; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 72 low / 80 high; official news 1 Sep 2026 gives only 'late Nov-early Dec 2026' (skiresort lists 21 Nov 2026); Passo Giau often closed in winter, use SS51 Alemagna or Falzarego/Valparola; 2026 Olympic venue.

opening_source_note: dovesciare/scimagazine (Arabba 4 Dec 2025, Marmolada cable cars 13 Dec); 2026/27 = Sellaronda date per valgardena.it/fassa.com
piste_km_basis: Arabba-Marmolada valley pass (skiresort/DSS 63 km)
score_notes: Porta Vescovo north faces, Padon and the 12 km Bellunese plus Marmolada glacier off-piste give the Dolomites' best lift-served freeride (rubric example); Marmolada, Sella and Padon offer many documented tours with local guides.
comments: Marmolada glacier lift-served to Punta Rocca (official 3265 m, skiresort 3269 m) but only Dec-Apr, no autumn glacier skiing; 2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 68 low / 75 high; 2026/27 date not resort-published (arabba.it silent, skiresort lists 28 Nov 2026), taken from Sellaronda opening 4 Dec 2026; Passo Fedaia road to Malga Ciapela can close in winter; from Milan via A22 Ora-Fassa-Passo Pordoi or Belluno-Val Cordevole (no pass).

opening_source_note: schneehoehen/Dolomiti Review 2 Dec 2025 (Zoldo sector open since 29 Nov, confirmed); 2026/27 not published
piste_km_basis: Ski Civetta valley pass (skiresort 72 km; skicivetta.com blocked automated access)
score_notes: Civetta north-side itineraries from Col dei Baldi/Fertazza and Zoldo tree runs are known locally with guide-led options; Civetta, Pelmo and Moiazza groups offer documented tours from Val di Zoldo but on a limited scale.
comments: skicivetta.com returned HTTP 403 to automated requests, so km/elevation from skiresort and prices from DSS press (2025/26 valley 1-day EUR 63 low / 70 high); Ski Civetta covers Alleghe (base used here), Selva di Cadore, Palafavera and Val di Zoldo (Pecol); skiresort lists 2026/27 season 28 Nov 2026-4 Apr 2027 (unverified); Passo Giau/Staulanza may close in winter; from Milan via Belluno-Agordo-Alleghe.
